briefing_summary: 本期日报覆盖8个版面。AI侧，Z.ai发布循环Transformer模型GLM-5.4，Inkling 2 Mini上线Vercel AI Gateway，Meta将Muse接入Instagram私信。Ladybird发布首个alpha，NASA征集月球核反应堆伙伴。俄方泄露数据据报显示对乌战争死亡近50万；乌方确认在利比亚附近以海上无人机袭俄船只。中国空间站首迎外籍航天员。AI担忧引发科技股抛售，Anthropic跌破IPO价。
briefing_title_en: AI Model and Agent Updates Meet Geopolitical and Market Risks
briefing_summary_en: This briefing covers eight sections. AI highlights include Z.ai's GLM-5.4 looped-transformer model, Inkling 2 Mini on Vercel AI Gateway, and Meta's Muse integration into Instagram DMs. Ladybird shipped its first alpha, and NASA is seeking partners for a lunar reactor. Leaked Russian data reportedly show nearly 500,000 war deaths in Ukraine, while Ukraine confirmed naval drone strikes off Libya. Tiangong received its first foreign astronaut. AI worries drove a tech selloff, and Anthropic fell below its IPO price.
